modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Reserve repository, read each bounded record using returned next ID, validate header/length/type and decode standard/OEM content with loop/expiry/end-marker handling.

modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: High-level listing may cover inventory but not raw Get SDR protocol; using only one transport leaves the other original checkpoint unverified unless Project SPEC overrides it.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Traversal or parser errors can misrepresent sensor definitions and topology.

project_override_considerations: IB/OOB or vendor API choice follows Project SPEC, but equivalent record fields, traversal/error evidence and untested original method must be recorded.

Coverage difference for any skipped transport

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master mixes IB identity with IB and OOB actions, uses zero reservation and incomplete one-byte record ID, and recommends linear guessing; Criteria checks only transport. DeepSeek hides these semantics behind high-level listing.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The read protocol and intent are identifiable; exact parser, reservation and Project transport scope are readiness inputs, so a safe bounded package is feasible.

review_improvement: Defines valid tokenized traversal and record semantics while preserving transport coverage differences and preventing brute-force enumeration.
independent_technical_reasoning: Get SDR is read-only and deterministically traversable through returned next IDs with bounded parsing. Once schema and scope are approved it is FULLY AUTOMATABLE, with no mutation or subjective user judgment.
